min_degree_at_least.note: Every vertex has at least d neighbours, forall v, d <= #|N(v)|: a universal lower bound, not an attained minimum. K0 and an empty induced subgraph satisfy every bound; the bound 0 always holds, the bound is antitone, regular graphs, complete and complete bipartite graphs and k-connected graphs satisfy their degree bounds, isomorphisms preserve it, and with a vertex it is at most Delta and below the order. Bound 1 is no isolated vertices.
